worksheets.title: Instructions
values: Annotate each element row in this tab.
When finished: mark 'element_prescreening' as 'ready-for-review' in the Status tab.
The coordinator will then regenerate the dependent tab.
This tab is generated after element_prescreening is imported.
Do NOT annotate it until the coordinator confirms regeneration is complete.
STEP 1 — element_prescreening: For each element, annotate scopal with one value:
y    = this element always participates in fixed-order (scopally meaningful) pairs
n    = this element has no meaningful variable ordering; it will be EXCLUDED from
both = this element has mixed behavior: some pairs are scopal, some are freely variable
When finished, mark element_prescreening as "ready-for-review" in the Status tab. The coordinator will then regenerate the general tab with a filtered pair list.
STEP 2 — general: Do NOT annotate this tab until the coordinator confirms it has been regenerated after Step 1 is complete. Once regenerated, annotate each pair:
scopal = y  means these two elements must appear in a fixed order (the order
scopal = n  means these two elements can appear in either order freely (no
